description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl Stream unlocks the value of all machine data by giving users a new level of observability, intelligence, and control over real-time data. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help shape the systems that let customers operate Cribl Stream reliably and confidently at scale.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Stream Control Plane team,you will be a technical expert working alongside skilled engineers as part of a cross functional team that delivers highly reliable and scalable software to drive customer value and satisfaction. You’ll help set technical direction for the deployment, configuration, and orchestration of distributed nodes, improving the scalability, resilience, security, and operability of the platform. 

This is a fully remote role, and Cribl is a remote-first company. Our culture embraces the diversity of team members across the globe.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Design, build, and evolve the services and APIs that power reliable deployment, configuration, and orchestration of Cribl Stream’s distributed nodes at scale.
  • Lead the technical approach for systems that must meet demanding availability, performance, scalability, and operational requirements, while balancing delivery speed and maintainability.
  • Partner with engineers, product managers, and designers to turn product requirements into practical technical designs and high-quality implementations
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, implement, review, test, and troubleshoot critical parts of the system, and help teams navigate complex technical problems.
  • Raise the quality of engineering design and execution through thoughtful design reviews, code reviews, testing strategies, and reusable patterns.
  • Improve the reliability and operability of production services through observability, capacity and performance improvements, incident learning, and automation.
  • Mentor and coach engineers, helping strengthen technical judgment, ownership, and engineering practices across the team.
  • Use AI-assisted tools and agentic workflows effectively in development, debugging, testing, and operational work, applying sound engineering judgment to their use.
  • Help maintain and support our SaaS offerings, including participation in a 24x7 on-call rotation and occasional stand-by, on-call, or off-hours responsibilities as needed.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Applicants must be able to comply with U.S. government security requirements for access to FedRAMP-authorized systems, which may include U.S. citizenship and US residence.
  • BS in CS/EE with 7+ years of experience or MS with 4+ years
  • Strong hands-on software development experience delivering production systems and customer-facing capabilities in cloud environments such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Significant experience designing, building, and operating production APIs and services, such as REST or RPC interfaces.
  • Strong coding experience with Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, or the ability to contribute effectively in a comparable modern programming ecosystem.
  • Experience with production operations, including on-call participation, incident response, and using operational feedback to improve system resilience.
  • Knowledge of or experience with data streaming and transformation, high-volume telemetry, logs, metrics, or observability systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics and build alignment in remote, distributed teams.
  • A track record of ownership, sound technical judgment, and delivering durable outcomes in fast-paced, collaborative environments.
  • Comfortable working in an AI-native, agentic engineering environment and using AI-assisted tools to improve productivity, code quality, and customer outcomes.

#LI-EL1
#LI-Remote

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$200,000—$240,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.
